title: Renders read as 'late teens / early twenties' — persona age is undefined, and the reference workflow carried juvenile-adjacent tokens
evidence: Independent vision reads of three production renders all returned a youthful age: gen-1789832734 -> 'a young girl, likely a teenager'; gen-1789833673 -> 'late teens or early twenties'; gen-1789834527 -> 'late teens or early twenties'. The read is stable BEFORE and AFTER the checkpoint change (cyberrealisticpony -> Pornmaster), so it comes from the persona preset / identity LoRA, not the base model. Contributing inputs: the workflow preset carries 'petite face, small nose' (node 88), and the reference pipeline-20 preset additionally carried 'underbooba, underboobs' alongside the identity tokens (sarah1a3, s1_dram). The images themselves are fully dressed and pass the NSFW gate comfortably (0.0004-0.0722 against ~0.5), so this is NOT a gate failure -- it is an audience-fit and platform-risk question for a public Instagram account.

notes.note: 2026-09-20 20:0xZ ops-triage: unchanged as a DECISION item (no age stated anywhere; guessing changes who Sarah is), but this run pinned the deterministic driver in LIVE production data and filed it separately as persona-preset-suppresses-adult-features. Production renders use pipeline 'turbo-one-step-clean' (id 21, 280 runs, newest 2026-09-19) whose step id 40 has node 79 as the NEGATIVE prompt wired to the sampler (node 96 KSampler negative=[79,0]): '..., long neck, adult, mature_face, sunken_eyes'. The pipeline therefore conditions against adult features on every render -- that, plus node 88's 'petite face, small nose', is why the vision reads come back late-teens regardless of checkpoint. The juvenile-adjacent tokens previously cited from the reference workflow (petite/underboob/young teenager) are NOT in the live production step: 'underbooba, underboobs' sits in pipeline 20 (fallback, last ran 2026-08-24) and 'young teenager' in pipeline 17 (legacy, last ran 2026-05-26).
